title: Subscription refusal passes silently when the factory cannot be asked
description:
When the factory can't be asked, nothing refuses a claude config with no subscription token. The run-start check (checkSelectedConfigCanRoute) returns nil on any seam error. Doctor reports routing OK when doctorClaudeSubLabels errors. The cloud submission preflight returns before the subscription question when the factory reports no harness_kinds. Tick tda's [3] says doctor and the preflight refuse an unroutable config, including a claude config with no token; at minimum doctor should warn that the subscription question went unanswered. The tests currently treat this as intended.
evidence: internal/reconcile/runconfig_select.go checkSelectedConfigCanRoute (err -> nil); internal/cli/doctor.go named-config routing check; internal/cli/cloud_harness_preflight.go len(facts.HarnessKinds)==0 early return
